title: Technology Sector Update for 01/25/2019: AMD,CLRO,INTC,ERIC - Nasdaq.com
text:

Technology stocks were helping carry the broader markets higher Firday, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding about 1.4% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 2.3%.
Among technology stocks moving:
(+) Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ) was ahead 4.5% Friday. The company said Friday it was consolidating all of its sales operations under its new chief sales officer Darren Grasby, who had been previously responsible for worldwide sales to PC manufacturers and channel partners. The chipmaker also created a new position, hiring former Ericsson ( ERIC ) engineering executive Sandeep Chennakesku to be its executive vice president for computing and graphics.
In other sector news:
(+) ClearOne ( CLRO ) surged 17.5% on Friday after the US Patent and Trademark Office upheld the patents underlying its technology used in beam-forming microphone arrays in a patent dispute with Shure Inc.
(-) Intel ( INTC ) was down over 5% after the chip giant late Thursday reported a 9% year-over-year increase in Q4 revenue to a record $18.66 billion but still lagged the Capital IQ consensus expecting $19.02 billion in revenue for the three months ended Dec. 29. It also forecast turnover would lag market projections during the current quarter as well as FY19.
